#### `catalog_change`

Append-only fact of every catalog write (before and after row snapshots with actor), the only customer-less fact table

- **Writer:** customerFacts.catalogChange (via catalogService.logCatalogChange, every catalog write verb), customerFacts.catalogChangeBackfill
- **Readers:** customerIntegrity (check 6 and informational comparison with api_event), customerReads (reserved, no reader yet)
- **Since:** 2026-09-27

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | Surrogate UUID primary key of this fact row. |
| `occurred_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | UTC timestamp of the catalog change; database clock at insert, set explicitly only by backfill. |
| `recorded_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | UTC timestamp the row was recorded; normally equal to occurred_at. |
| `source` | text | no | Origin of the fact, idempotency key with source_id. One of: catalogService, backfill (type-enforced in code, no DB CHECK); in practice catalogService. |
| `source_id` | text | no | Idempotency key within source, built as uuid:entity:entity_id so two writes to one entity in a transaction never collide; UNIQUE (source, source_id). |
| `catalog_version` | text | yes | Catalog version string from getCatalogVersion() when the change was recorded. |
| `entity` | text | no | Kind of catalog entity changed, such as coffee, coffee_slot_assignment, category, archetype, hop, roaster, coffee_retail_price. |
| `entity_id` | text | no | Primary key of the changed entity as text (composite keys joined with a colon, for example coffee_id:weight_oz). |
| `action` | text | no | Name of the catalogService verb that made the change, such as placeCoffee, moveCoffee, retireCoffee, setHop. |
| `before` | jsonb | yes | JSON snapshot of the whole entity row before the change; NULL for creates. |
| `after` | jsonb | yes | JSON snapshot of the whole entity row after the change; NULL for deletes. |
| `changed_by` | text | yes | Actor who made the change: an admin uid, or import or system for non-interactive writes. |

| `superseded_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp a newer row replaced this one (a re-save, a transcription correction or a re-merge); NULL marks the current row. Set once, together with superseded_by_id and supersede_reason. |

| `supersede_reason` | text | yes | Why the row was replaced (edited in Score Entry, transcription correction: ..., merged by rule again, replaced by a manual merge); NULL while current. |

|---|---|---|---|

#### `order`

One checkout order placed through the site and mirrored to Shopify, with a shipping-address snapshot (immutable fact).

- **Writer:** orders.POST /api/orders
- **Readers:** orders, users, userSignals, qrDoor, catalogService, brewCard, behavioralConfidence, +4 more
- **Since:** 2026-05-22

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | Surrogate UUID primary key; referenced by order_line_item.order_id, roastery_shipment_details.order_id and notification_log.order_id. |
| `user_id` | uuid | yes | FK to user_profile(id); the buyer. |
| `household_id` | uuid | yes | FK to household(id); never set by any code path (confirmed in Customer Blueprint C2 Task 0), always NULL. |
| `external_shopify_order_id` | text | yes | ID of the matching order in Shopify, returned when the order was created there. |
| `fulfillment_status` | text | yes | Fulfilment state as free text, written as pending at checkout and never updated today; catalogService (open orders per roaster) treats delivered and cancelled as closed, while the Stripe brief plans pending, awaiting_manual, placed, shipped, delivered, canceled, needs_attention; that brief must settle the canceled vs cancelled spelling before any CHECK is added. |
| `is_subscription` | boolean | yes | True if the order is a subscription renewal, default false; reserved for the Stripe brief (createSubscriptionOrder sets it), never written today. |
| `subtotal` | numeric | yes | Sum of line prices times quantity in dollars (numeric, not cents), computed at checkout. |
| `shipping_fee_charged` | numeric | yes | Shipping fee charged to the customer in USD dollars (same unit as total_amount_paid), default 0.00; reserved for the Stripe brief, never written today. |
| `taxes_collected` | numeric | yes | Sales tax collected in USD dollars (same unit as total_amount_paid), default 0.00; reserved for the Stripe brief (automatic tax), never written today. |
| `transaction_fee` | numeric | yes | Payment-processing fee in USD dollars (same unit as total_amount_paid), default 0.00; reserved for the Stripe brief (from the balance transaction), never written today. |
| `total_amount_paid` | numeric | yes | Amount paid in dollars; at checkout it is set equal to subtotal (no shipping or tax added). |
| `currency` | text | yes | ISO currency code of the amounts; always the default USD, never set by code. |
| `promo_code` | text | yes | Promo code applied to the order; reserved, never written today (NULL); the Stripe brief decides whether Stripe promotion codes are mirrored here. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp when the order row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp of the last change; no code updates the row after insert. |
| `shipping_street` | text | yes | Street line of the shipping address snapshot copied at checkout. |
| `shipping_city` | text | yes | City of the shipping address snapshot copied at checkout. |

#### `api_event`

Append-only capture-first log of every mutating API request (redacted body, status, duration), also carrying client-side errors from POST /api/client-errors

- **Writer:** apiEventLog.apiEventLog (INSERT before the handler, UPDATE at response finish), apiEventLog.writeOutcome
- **Readers:** admin GET /system-health, catalogReads.getChanges, quizIntegrity, customerIntegrity, scripts/audit-quiz-emails.mjs
- **Since:** 2026-08-13

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | UUID primary key generated by the middleware per request (also exposed to handlers as res.locals.apiEventId). |
| `occurred_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | UTC timestamp the request was captured (database now() at insert). |
| `call_type` | text | no | Route-pattern label such as POST /api/orders/:id/cancel, stable across ids; provisional at insert and corrected at finish. |
| `method` | text | no | HTTP method: POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE. |
| `path` | text | no | Request originalUrl without the query string. |
| `firebase_uid` | text | yes | Firebase uid of the caller, filled at response finish once auth middleware ran; NULL if unauthenticated or the request never finished. |
| `is_anonymous` | boolean | yes | True if the caller was an anonymous Firebase session; NULL when unknown. |
| `request_body` | jsonb | yes | JSON request body with secret-like keys redacted and truncated over 64 KB; NULL when there was no body. |
| `body_truncated` | boolean | no | True if request_body was cut at the size cap. |
| `response_status` | integer | yes | HTTP response status; 499 = client closed the connection first; NULL = captured but never finished (crash or instance death). |
| `response_error` | jsonb | yes | JSON response body (redacted, capped at 2 KB) when status is 400 or higher, or the client-closed marker for 499; otherwise NULL. |
| `duration_ms` | integer | yes | Request duration in milliseconds, set at response finish. |

| `descriptor` | text | no | The flavor descriptor word or phrase itself, e.g. Jasmine. |
| `intensity_score` | numeric | yes | Class: deprecated \| DEPRECATED 2026-10-16: never written; cupping_note is the descriptor vocabulary, and the intensity a descriptor showed in a cupping lives on cupping_score_descriptors.intensity (0-15). |
| `ai_metadata` | jsonb | yes | Class: deprecated \| DEPRECATED 2026-10-16: JSONB never written, read or documented. |
| `is_active` | boolean | yes | True when the descriptor is part of the active wheel; catalogService and the roastery portal only accept active descriptors. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp when the row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp of last update; no code path updates it after seeding. |
| `descriptor_source_id` | integer | yes | References sensory_source.id: where the term comes from; the 84 original rows point at wcr_lexicon (set by schema.sql UPDATE), the tier-1 and tier-2 nodes added by cupping evidence brief 1 at sca_flavor_wheel. |
| `lexicon_section` | text | yes | Name of the WCR Sensory Lexicon section the descriptor maps to; backfilled from sensory_lexicon_attribute.section. |
| `tier` | smallint | no | SCA wheel level of the node: 1 family (Fruity), 2 sub-group (Berry, or a childless node such as Black Tea), 3 leaf (Blueberry). A word is stored at the tier the person named, never deeper \| Writer: seed |
| `parent_id` | uuid | yes | References cupping_note.id: the node one tier up (leaf to sub-group, sub-group to family); NULL exactly on tier-1 rows (CHECK cupping_note_tier_parent); backfilled from the labels by schema.sql \| Writer: seed |

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|

#### `dial_position_signal`

One row per source's opinion about where a coffee sits on its dial (cupping, roastery_wheel, client_wheel, sms_feedback, onsite_feedback), read only by the dormant consensus view and an admin stats count; never auto-moves a placement.

- **Writer:** dialPositionSignal.writeDialPositionSignal, dialSuggestion.recordCuppingSignal, orders.POST /api/orders/:orderId/feedback (supersede only); seed
- **Readers:** v_coffee_dial_position_consensus, axis (GET /stats)
- **Since:** 2026-07-09 (#75)

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | no | Surrogate key for the signal row. |
| `coffee_id` | integer | yes | References coffees.id, the coffee the signal is about (ON DELETE RESTRICT since cupping evidence brief 1); nullable in the schema but always set by the writers. |
| `archetype` | archetype_enum | no | archetype_enum dial the signal applies to; taken from the coffee's current match archetype. |
| `dimension_id` | integer | no | References coffee_dimensions.id, the archetype's dominant dimension that the signal speaks to. |
| `source` | text | no | Where the opinion came from. One of: cupping, roastery_wheel, client_wheel, sms_feedback, onsite_feedback (CHECK); joins dial_source_weight.source. |
| `direction` | text | yes | Which way the source says the coffee should move on the dimension. One of: more, less (CHECK); NULL for cupping rows. \| Writer: dialPositionSignal.writeDialPositionSignal |
| `raw_value` | numeric | yes | Cupping rows: the midpoint of the coffee's latest merged range on dimension_id, 0 to 15 (v_coffee_dimension_range, cupping evidence brief 1; was an average over every merged row); NULL for feedback rows. \| Writer: dialSuggestion.recordCuppingSignal |
| `sample_size` | integer | no | Number of observations behind the row: sessions with a current merged row for cupping rows, 1 for each feedback row. |
| `confidence` | confidence_enum | yes | Confidence in the signal. One of: low, medium, high (confidence_enum); defaults to medium and no writer sets any other value. |
| `computed_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp the signal was recorded. |
| `superseded_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp a newer signal replaced this one; NULL means current, and only current rows feed the consensus view. \| Writer: dialSuggestion.recordCuppingSignal, orders.POST /:orderId/feedback |
| `notes` | text | yes | For feedback rows a match key such as "onsite feedback for order <id>" that the order-feedback revision path uses to supersede the prior row; for cupping rows written since cupping evidence brief 1 the basis of the suggested slot (spec_band, or archetype_vector (May 2026 targets) while any slot of the archetype lacks a band); NULL on older cupping rows. \| Writer: dialPositionSignal.writeDialPositionSignal, dialSuggestion.recordCuppingSignal |
| `suggested_slot_id` | integer | yes | References coffee_dial_slot.id, the slot the source suggests (replaced the dropped suggested_vocabulary_id in brief 5a); set only on cupping rows, NULL for feedback rows. \| Writer: dialSuggestion.recordCuppingSignal |

|---|---|---|---|

#### `roastery_portal_response`

One row per lineup coffee per version holding the roaster's own answers (draft or submitted); submitted rows are immutable by trigger and reopening starts version plus 1.

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | Primary key (UUID); referenced by the child note, dimension and brew tables and by roastery_portal_acceptance. |
| `portal_coffee_id` | uuid | no | FK to roastery_portal_coffee(id): the lineup coffee this answer is about. |
| `version` | integer | no | Version number starting at 1, unique per portal_coffee_id; a new draft is version plus 1 of the latest. |
| `status` | text | no | One of: draft, submitted; at most one draft per coffee, and a submitted row is never changed again. \| Writer: roasteryPortalService.submitResponse |
| `origin` | text | yes | Origin as the roaster states it for this version; NULL if unanswered. |
| `process_values` | text[] | no | Processing methods, lookup_value category process values; empty array if unanswered. |
| `roast_level` | text | yes | Roast level, a lookup_value roast_level value; NULL if unanswered. |
| `blend_or_single` | text | yes | lookup_value blend_or_single value (single or blend); NULL if unanswered. |
| `is_decaf` | boolean | yes | Class: deprecated \| Old decaf yes/no answer; nothing writes it any more (never copied into new drafts, submitted rows never backfilled); v_roastery_portal_response derives caffeine_level from it for old rows. |
| `proposed_archetype` | archetype_enum | yes | The archetype_enum family the roaster proposes for the coffee; a proposal only, never an assignment; NULL if unanswered. |
| `dominant_dimension_id` | integer | yes | FK to coffee_dimensions(id): the dimension the roaster says dominates this coffee; NULL if unanswered. |
| `takes_it` | text | yes | How the coffee is best enjoyed. One of: black, milk, both; NULL if unanswered. |
| `brew_notes` | text | yes | Free-text brewing notes; NULL if unanswered. |
| `availability` | text | yes | Availability pattern, a lookup_value roastery_portal_availability value (always_on, rotating, limited_release); NULL if unanswered. |
| `typical_notice` | text | yes | Per-coffee override of the lineup answer on how much notice before it goes out of stock, a lookup_value roastery_portal_notice value; NULL means same as the lineup answer. |
| `expected_availability` | text | yes | Free-text expected availability (for example when it returns); NULL if unanswered. |
| `similar_when_out` | text | yes | Per-coffee override of the lineup answer on whether a similar profile replaces it when out, a lookup_value roastery_portal_similar value (yes, usually, sometimes, no, not_sure); NULL means same as the lineup answer. |
| `closest_cousin_portal_coffee_id` | uuid | yes | FK to roastery_portal_coffee(id): the roastery's own coffee this one is closest to; NULL if unanswered. |
| `what_changes` | text | yes | Free text on what differs from the closest cousin; NULL if unanswered. |
| `anything_else` | text | yes | Free-text closing remarks about this coffee; NULL if unanswered. |
| `last_saved_by_respondent_id` | uuid | yes | FK to roastery_portal_respondent(id): who last saved this version. |
| `submitted_by_respondent_id` | uuid | yes | FK to roastery_portal_respondent(id): who submitted this version; NULL while draft. \| Writer: roasteryPortalService.submitResponse |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | Timestamp when this version (draft) was opened. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | Timestamp of the last save or submit. |
| `submitted_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | Timestamp when the version was submitted; NULL while draft. \| Writer: roasteryPortalService.submitResponse |
| `additives_present` | boolean | yes | True if anything is added to the coffee (flavoring etc.), false if not, NULL if unanswered. |
| `additives_detail` | text | yes | Free text on what is added; only kept when additives_present is true, else NULL. |
| `roast_intent` | text | yes | Class: deprecated \| Old Roasted-for answer (lookup roastery_portal_roast_intent: filter, espresso, omni); removed in part 4 (#213), nothing in code reads or writes it. |
| `blend_components` | text | yes | Free text describing the blend's components; only kept for blends, else NULL. |
| `blend_rotation` | text | yes | How the blend recipe changes. One of: fixed, rotates_same_profile, seasonal (lookup roastery_portal_blend_rotation); only kept for blends, else NULL. |
| `caffeine_level` | text | yes | Caffeine answer. One of: regular, half_caff, decaf (lookup roastery_portal_caffeine); NULL if unanswered (readers use v_roastery_portal_response, which falls back to is_decaf). |
| `decaf_process` | text | yes | Decaffeination process. One of: swiss_water, sugarcane_ea, mountain_water, co2, other; only kept when caffeine_level is decaf or half_caff, else NULL. |
| `certifications` | text[] | no | Certifications held, lookup roastery_portal_certification values (usda_organic, fair_trade, rainforest_alliance, other, none); none stands alone; empty array if unanswered. |

#### `sommelier_evaluation`

One row per Liam sommelier evaluation of a user (intent, 13-dim feature vector, state snapshot) plus a JSONB outcome merged in later; replaced Firestore sommelier_evaluations.

- **Writer:** outcomeTracker.writeOutcome, sommelier.POST /api/sommelier/start, sommelierEvaluator.evaluateSommelier
- **Readers:** admin.GET /sommelier/stats, admin.POST /sommelier/recompute-centroids, outcomeTracker +2 fns
- **Since:** 2026-09-27 (Customer Blueprint C3 Part B6)

| column | type | null | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | Primary key (UUID); returned to the session as evaluationId and stored on the Liam session context. |
| `user_id` | uuid | no | FK to user_profile(id) (the profile id, not the Firebase uid the evaluator receives; resolved once at insert). |
| `intent` | text | no | Name of the first matched intent rule (highest-priority trigger that fired and is active in config). |
| `triggers_fired` | text[] | no | Names of every intent rule that fired for this evaluation, in priority order. |
| `needs_sommelier` | boolean | no | True when the evaluator decided a sommelier session is warranted; the only insert path always writes true (non-triggering evaluations are not logged). |
| `feature_vector` | numeric[] | no | The 13 numeric features (mostly 0-1 normalised) computed for this evaluation, positionally aligned with feature_schema; used for intent centroid recomputation. |
| `feature_schema` | text[] | no | Feature names in the same order as feature_vector (FEATURE_SCHEMA in sommelierEvaluator.ts), stored so old vectors stay interpretable if the schema changes. |
| `user_state_snapshot` | jsonb | no | JSONB snapshot of the user's quiz, order and feedback state at evaluation time. |
| `opening_context` | text | yes | Generated opening sentence(s) handed to Liam to start the session; NULL if none. |
| `session_started` | boolean | no | True once the user actually opened a Liam session from this evaluation. \| Writer: sommelier.POST /start |
| `started_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | UTC timestamp when the Liam session started; NULL until session_started is set. \| Writer: sommelier.POST /start |
| `outcome` | jsonb | no | JSONB shallow-merged over time (jsonb concat) with sessionCompleted, turnsUsed, tokensSpent, orderedWithin7Days, orderedWithin30Days, feedbackAfterSession, returnedToSommelier and outcomeUpdatedAt (ISO string). \| Writer: outcomeTracker.writeOutcome |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | UTC timestamp when the evaluation row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | UTC timestamp of the last change; set again by the session-start update and every outcome merge. \| Writer: sommelier.POST /start, outcomeTracker.writeOutcome |

- **Since:** 2026-08-31

Archetype target range (min, ideal, max, the May 2026 archetype_vector targets) beside the average midpoint of the latest merged cupping range (v_coffee_dimension_range) of the active coffees matched to the archetype, and their count, per archetype x dimension.

- **Readers:** coffees (GET /archetype-stats), dialSuggestion
- **Since:** 2026-06-12 (latest merged range: 2026-10-18)

Newsletter subscriber count and percent share per archetype, from subscribers whose signup came through a quiz.

- **Readers:** Looker Studio via reporting_ro
- **Since:** 2026-07-22
- **reads:** `newsletter_subscriber`

Target flavor vector per archetype, one row per archetype x dimension with min, ideal and max score.

- **Readers:** axis (GET /vectors), coffees (archetype-order distance)
- **Since:** 2026-06-12

One row per coffee (active or not) with roaster name, current match archetype and category codes, the one read model for a coffee's identity

One row per coffee archetype (all six including experimental) exposing code, label and dial metadata, replacing hand-typed archetype name maps

#### `v_coffee_dimension_history`

Every session's current merged range per coffee x dimension x sample, converted to 0 to 15, with session date, blind and control flags and the scales behind it; what calibration and repeatability read (the catalog reads the latest session only).

- **Readers:** cuppingReads
- **Since:** 2026-10-18 (cupping evidence brief 1)

#### `v_coffee_dimension_range`

Per active coffee and cupping dimension, the range of the LATEST current merged row (by session date), converted to 0 to 15, with session_id, session_date, n_sessions, midpoint and all_ab_scale (falling back to the latest session's cupper rows when the coffee has no merged row); never unions sessions; no row if never cupped.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** cuppingReads, roasteryPortalReads, customerIntegrity, v_archetype_dimension_comparison, v_coffee_dimension_range_calibrated, v_palate_shared_traits, +3 more
- **Since:** 2026-09-27 (latest session: 2026-10-18)
- **reads:** `coffee_dimensions`, `coffees`, `cupping_score_values`, `cupping_scores`, `cupping_session_coffees`, `cupping_sessions`

#### `v_coffee_dimension_range_calibrated`

v_coffee_dimension_range with each cupper's current cupper_calibration_offset applied to her converted range behind the latest merge; calibrated_min/max/midpoint and n_offsets_applied. Unread on purpose until Dana decides offsets apply.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** none yet
- **Since:** 2026-10-18 (cupping evidence brief 1)
- **reads:** `cupper_calibration_offset`, `cupping_score_values`, `cupping_scores`, `cupping_session_coffees`, `v_coffee_dimension_range`

#### `v_evidence_dimension`

One row per coffee x numeric dimension x cupper: the cupper's latest current range (converted to 0 to 15), the latest merged range repeated, the scales behind it, whether the cuppers agree (gap <= param cupper_gap), the roaster's 1 to 5 value and both average ranks within the roastery's lineup, and a flag (none, cuppers_disagree, roaster_disagrees, both, one_source). No cupper named in the definition.

- **Since:** 2026-10-18 (cupping evidence brief 3)

- **Readers:** evidenceReads.getRoasteryEvidence (admin Roastery Feedback, Calibration), reporting_ro
- **Since:** 2026-10-18 (cupping evidence brief 3)
- **reads:** `coffee_dimensions`, `v_coffee`, `v_coffee_dimension_history`, `v_cupping_session`, `v_evidence_archetype`, `v_evidence_descriptor`, `v_roastery_portal_coffee_hint`

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** roasteryPortalReads
- **Since:** 2026-10-05 (Roastery portal part 2 #210)
- **reads:** `coffee_archetype`, `coffee_archetype_assignment`, `coffee_dial_slot`, `coffee_dimensions`, `coffee_slot_assignment`, `v_coffee_dimension_range`, `v_roastery_portal_coffee_hint`

#### `v_roastery_portal_lineup_current_response`

Per roastery, the open lineup-wide draft if one exists else the latest submitted lineup response.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** roasteryPortalReads
- **Since:** 2026-10-05 (Roastery portal part 2 #210)
- **reads:** `roastery_portal_lineup_response`

#### `v_roastery_portal_progress`

Per lineup coffee: state (not_started, in_progress, submitted), sections answered 0 to 6, who saved or submitted and when, version counts, unmapped-notes flag and accepted-version status for the admin review list.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** roasteryPortalReads
- **Since:** 2026-10-05 (Roastery portal #209; accepted-version columns #210, additives columns #212)
- **reads:** `roastery_portal_acceptance`, `roastery_portal_coffee`, `roastery_portal_respondent`, `roastery_portal_response`, `roastery_portal_response_brew`, `roastery_portal_response_dimension`, `roastery_portal_response_note`, `v_roastery_portal_current_response`, `v_roastery_portal_response`

#### `v_roastery_portal_response`

Every roastery_portal_response version with one effective caffeine_level (the new column, else decaf or regular derived from the deprecated is_decaf) and without roast_intent; the single definition for reading a version.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** roasteryPortalReads, roasteryPortalService.openDraft, roasteryPortalService.acceptResponse, v_roastery_portal_current_response, v_roastery_portal_progress
- **Since:** 2026-10-06 (Roastery portal part 3 #212)
- **reads:** `roastery_portal_response`

#### `v_roastery_remark`

Every roaster remark with roaster, coffee and lineup names, the SCA node (descriptor, category, sub-group, tier) and is_current (no newer row supersedes it).

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** roasteryRemarkReads
- **Since:** 2026-10-18 (cupping evidence brief 1)
- **reads:** `coffees`, `cupping_note`, `roaster`, `roastery_portal_coffee`, `roastery_remark`

#### `v_subscriber_quiz_results`

One row per newsletter subscriber joined to their most recent quiz session and its current interpretation, for Looker Studio and calibration exports

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** reporting_ro (Looker Studio), manual CSV exports (scripts/quizRecalibrate.ts input), no app code
- **Since:** 2026-09-20
- **reads:** `coffee_archetype`, `newsletter_subscriber`, `quiz_answer`, `quiz_session`, `quiz_session_interpretation`, `subscriber_source`

#### `v_subscribers_weekly`

Weekly new newsletter subscriber counts broken down by signup source, for the marketing dashboard.

- **Writer:** none (derived)
- **Readers:** Looker Studio via reporting_ro
- **Since:** 2026-07-22
- **reads:** `newsletter_subscriber`, `subscriber_source`
